features.F1: native_payload — the APK ships a native payload (lib/<abi>/*.so or an ELF under assets/), or calls System/Runtime loadLibrary/load, or declares a native method nothing in the APK implements.
features.F2: dynamic_invoke — decoded bytecode contains invoke-polymorphic, invoke-custom, or const-method-handle.
features.F3: trust_client_api — the APK references a Play Integrity, SafetyNet, Play Services, licensing or DRM client API (MediaDrm and com.widevine included).
features.F4: build_identity — an instruction reads an android.os.Build identity field.
features.F5: reflection — a decoded call site targets Class.forName / getMethod(s) / getDeclaredMethod(s) / Field.setAccessible / Method.invoke / Proxy.newProxyInstance / ClassLoader.loadClass.
features.F6: dynamic_code — an external DexClassLoader / InMemoryDexClassLoader / PathClassLoader / BaseDexClassLoader class is referenced.

selection.rule: sort by packageName ascending (ties broken by versionCode), take the first 20
selection.why: Deterministic, re-derivable from the committed sample file with no extra tooling, and independent of every signal the analyzer reports.

sha256Verification.note: SHA-256 of the bytes actually fetched and analysed, cross-checked against the SHA-256 F-Droid publishes in its index for the same package+versionCode. This closes the gap corpus/report.md names: "SHA-256 values come from the F-Droid index and were not checked against the served bytes."

apps.note: 10 x lib/arm64-v8a/*.so and a System.loadLibrary("androidx.graphics.path") call site, so F1 is yes on two independent grounds. F3: MediaDrm/Widevine PSSH constants present. F6: PathClassLoader and BaseDexClassLoader are referenced but not defined here.

A 3 KB stub: 9 methods, no lib/ entry, no native declaration, no Build read, no reflective call site. F2 is yes on 9 const-method-handle instructions alone, which shows how little discriminative power a 99%-positive feature has.

lib/ entries for all four ABIs plus 59 native declarations. 3 loadLibrary call sites whose argument register was never written by a const-string in the same basic block, so the library names are unknown — F1 does not depend on them.
F3 is a single string constant, the descriptor Landroid/media/MediaDrm;. Thin evidence; recorded as yes because MediaDrm is the Widevine entry point, but a stricter rule would call this unknown.
No lib/ entry, no native declaration, no loadLibrary. The cleanest negative F1 in the native-free stratum.
F4 rests on a single sget of Build.FINGERPRINT. Labelled yes because the field is read, with the caveat that one read is very little evidence of dependency.
Flutter app: System.loadLibrary("flutter"), 6 lib/ entries, 38 native declarations.
Small: 628 methods, 5 const-method-handle, 9 reflection call sites, one sget of Build.MANUFACTURER.
The one DEX 039 app among the native-code group. 4 lib/ entries, 8 native declarations.
4 dex files, 13951 const-method-handle instructions in a single app. F3 from the MediaDrm descriptor constant.
F4 reads FINGERPRINT, MANUFACTURER and MODEL — three distinct identity fields, the strongest F4 evidence in the set.
6 x lib/x86_64/*.so (x86_64 only, a real-world packaging oddity), 47 native declarations, 4 named loadLibrary call sites including gojni and image_processing_util_jni.

F6 from a BaseDexClassLoader reference. This is a keyboard language pack with no code of its own beyond the AnySoftKeyboard API, so the positive is plausible rather than certain — flagged as the weakest F6 label in the set.
Byte-for-byte the same DEX as the Esperanto pack apart from dictionary data; identical labels are the correct outcome, and their agreement tests nothing.
F2 on 4 invoke-custom sites and 1416 const-method-handle; no native anything.

Strongest Build identity coverage in the set: 19 distinct fields including BOOTLOADER, TAGS and SUPPORTED_ABIS, 25 reads. 4 loadLibrary call sites with no bound name, so the library identities are unknown — F1 rests on the 4 x lib/x86_64 entries and the 53 declarations.
267 Build identity reads across 8 distinct fields — 8x the read count of any other app in the set, which is the anti-tamper signature the taxonomy predicts for BUILD.*.
DEX 039, 3 loadLibrary-looking call sites absent; 2 invoke-custom and 1361 const-method-handle.

21 x lib/x86_64, 426 native declarations, 18 distinct Build identity fields. One inferred loadLibrary name is the bare string "lib", which is a mis-binding — the argument register was reused. F1 does not depend on it, and it is recorded here as a known analyzer defect on this app.
An SSH client with no native code at all. 2 /dev/* constants and 5 /system partition constants, which is the most substrate-specific string surface in the set even though F1 is no.
